comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 site key for the Admin panel's "I am not a robot" widget.
modal: The public site key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 ("I am not a robot"), used to render the checkbox widget on **Admin** forms. Stored encrypted.

comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 secret key used to verify Admin reCAPTCHA responses server-side.
modal: The secret key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2, used server-side to validate checkbox responses on the **Admin** panel. Stored encrypted; keep it confidential.

comment: The display size of the Admin reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
modal: Sets the size of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget shown on the Admin panel, to suit the form layout.

comment: The colour theme of the Admin reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
modal: Sets the colour theme of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget on the Admin panel, to match the surrounding page.

comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 site key for the storefront's "I am not a robot" widget.
modal: The public site key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 ("I am not a robot"), used to render the checkbox widget on **storefront** forms. Stored encrypted. Can differ per website.

comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 secret key used to verify storefront reCAPTCHA responses server-side.
modal: The secret key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2, used server-side to validate checkbox responses on the **storefront**. Stored encrypted; keep it confidential. Can differ per website.

comment: The display size of the storefront reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
modal: Sets the size of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget shown on the storefront, to suit the form layout. Can differ per website.

comment: The colour theme of the storefront reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
modal: Sets the colour theme of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget on the storefront, to match the surrounding page. Can differ per website.
